sources.label: Clean, ad-free Morphe patches for popular Android apps.
sources.author: GinArena
patch_list: Hide playback controls at stream open
Keeps playback controls hidden when a stream opens or the player switches between embedded and fullscreen. The controls remain available.
On Android TV, prefers the seekbar over play/pause when controls open. Seeking depends on the stream.
Removes ads and tracking, and hides the player app logo.
